headline: Saudi crown prince to attend G20 in the United States
summary: Saudi Arabia's crown prince will take part in the G20, which brings together major economies including the United States, China, India, Japan, France, Brazil, Mexico and Russia.
why: The G20 coordinates policy among the world's largest economies, and Saudi Arabia is a leading oil exporter and a G20 member.
original_headline: Príncipe heredero saudita participará en el G20 en Estados Unidos
